preflight.notes: Observed startup is kitchen firmware with no record partition. No Flash writes performed. Monitor open produced a USB_UART_CHIP_RESET; this is not a power-button test.

build.notes: Use the hash-verified published v0.4.1 images for this acceptance; no locally rebuilt image has been substituted.

battle.transport: loopback UDP, two native macOS processes
battle.notes: Host transport only; not physical ESP-NOW acceptance.

asset_repack.notes: No UI text, fonts, word list or static art changed; reused the verified release chunks and regenerated all seven animation packs.

checks.name: Upgrade preserves learning progress
checks.method: Capture status before and after flash_words.py <confirmed-port> --app on both badges.
checks.criteria: learned, coins and streak remain unchanged.

badge_a.notes: NOT RUN: installed kitchen firmware has an incompatible partition layout; app-only words upgrade cannot establish learning-record preservation.

checks.notes: Waiting for target identity confirmation and access to both badges.

checks.name: Frame time
checks.method: Reset perf counters for each scene, measure home for 30 seconds, answer 20 study questions, and measure stars for 10 seconds.
checks.criteria: Home average <= 20 ms and maximum <= 60 ms; record actual scene measurements.
checks.notes: Host UI checks do not establish physical frame times.

checks.name: Physical buttons
checks.method: Press up, down and OK 20 times each by hand; hold up for one second to return.
checks.criteria: No missed or duplicate input; return progress ring is visible.
checks.notes: Requires physical button operation and visual observation.

checks.name: Audio and mute
checks.method: Listen to correct, incorrect, completion and stamp cues; turn sound off in the menu.
checks.criteria: No clipping or harsh cues; complete silence while muted.
checks.notes: Requires listening on both physical badges.

checks.name: Two-badge battle and rematch
checks.method: Discover each other, challenge, finish ten questions, request a rematch and finish the second round.
checks.criteria: Scores agree with opposite player ordering; ratings increase and decrease consistently; word-bank exchange completes.
checks.notes: Both physical badges are required; loopback UDP is not device acceptance.

checks.name: Battle interruption
checks.method: During a battle, test long-press return and physical power-off of one peer.
checks.criteria: The other badge reports exit or disconnect within 15 seconds and remains responsive.
checks.notes: Record measured detection delays and both peer roles.

checks.name: Idle sleep and wake
checks.method: Leave untouched for five minutes, then wake using a physical button.
checks.criteria: Automatic deep sleep; wake returns home and preserves progress.
checks.notes: Do not poll serial commands during the idle interval; commands reset the idle timer.

checks.name: Overnight day rollover
checks.method: Complete today's study, keep battery power connected through overnight deep sleep, then wake the next day.
checks.criteria: New learning day and today's study are available; streak increases by one as specified by the roadmap. Record both wake-time and post-study status.
checks.notes: Requires actual overnight elapsed time. Simulated days do not satisfy this check.

checks.name: Power-loss behavior
checks.method: After completing today's study, remove battery power or use the power button, then restart.
checks.criteria: Record the observed behavior against the current v0.4.1 design; report any discrepancy.

checks.name: Power-button reset reason
checks.method: Power off and on with the badge's power button; capture the startup reset reason without a monitor-induced reset.
checks.criteria: Record whether the actual power-button cycle produces ESP_RST_POWERON.
checks.notes: No physical power-button cycle observed. A USB_UART_CHIP_RESET during serial access is excluded from this check. Report the physical result before selecting section 3.1.

checks.name: Repeated-scene memory stability
checks.method: Enter and leave battle ten times, and study and challenge five times each; capture status after every cycle.
checks.criteria: Heap stabilizes with no continuing decline or restart; distinguish first Wi-Fi initialization from a leak.

checks.name: One-day battery use
checks.method: Start fully charged, use normally on battery for one day, and record remaining battery level.
checks.criteria: Record start/end time, charging conditions, usage and remaining charge; verify how the measurement was obtained.
checks.notes: Requires actual battery-only use; USB-powered testing does not measure daily battery consumption.
